import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class J implements Runnable {

    private static final boolean ONLINE_JUDGE = System.getProperty("ONLINE_JUDGE") != null;

    private BufferedReader in;
    private PrintWriter out;
    private StringTokenizer tok = new StringTokenizer("");

    private void init() throws FileNotFoundException {
        Locale.setDefault(Locale.US);
        String fileName = "";
        if (ONLINE_JUDGE && fileName.isEmpty()) {
            in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
            out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        } else {
            if (fileName.isEmpty()) {
                in = new BufferedReader(new FileReader("input.txt"));
                out = new PrintWriter("output.txt");
            } else {
                in = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(fileName + ".in"));
                out = new PrintWriter(fileName + ".out");
            }
        }
    }

    String readString() throws IOException {
        while (!tok.hasMoreTokens()) {
            tok = new StringTokenizer(in.readLine());
        }
        return tok.nextToken();
    }

    int readInt() throws IOException {
        return Integer.parseInt(readString());
    }

    long readLong() throws IOException {
        return Long.parseLong(readString());
    }

    double readDouble() throws IOException {
        return Double.parseDouble(readString());
    }

    int[] readIntArray(int size) throws IOException {
        int[] a = new int[size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            a[i] = readInt();
        }
        return a;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new J().run();
    }

    long timeBegin, timeEnd;

    void time() {
        timeEnd = System.currentTimeMillis();
        System.err.println("Time = " + (timeEnd - timeBegin));
    }

    @Override
    public void run() {
        try {
            timeBegin = System.currentTimeMillis();
            init();
            solve();
            out.close();
            time();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
            System.exit(-1);
        }
    }

    int[][][][] dp;
    char[] s;
    int INF = 10000000;

    int solve(int v, int k, int x, int last) {
        if (v < 0 || k < 0 || x < 0) return INF;
        if (v == 0 && k == 0 && x == 0) return 0;
        
        if (dp[v][k][x][last] != -1) {
            return dp[v][k][x][last];
        }
        
        int res = INF;
        
        // Place 'V' (represented as 0)
        if (v > 0) {
            int cost = countCost('V', v, k, x, last);
            res = Math.min(res, cost + solve(v - 1, k, x, 0));
        }
        
        // Place 'K' (represented as 1)
        if (k > 0) {
            // Avoid creating "VK" - if last was 'V' (0), we cannot place 'K' (1)
            if (last != 0) {
                int cost = countCost('K', v, k, x, last);
                res = Math.min(res, cost + solve(v, k - 1, x, 1));
            }
        }
        
        // Place 'X' (represented as 2)
        if (x > 0) {
            int cost = countCost('X', v, k, x, last);
            res = Math.min(res, cost + solve(v, k, x - 1, 2));
        }
        
        dp[v][k][x][last] = res;
        return res;
    }

    int countCost(char target, int v, int k, int x, int last) {
        // Calculate how many positions we need to move to place target character
        // We need to count how many characters of other types are before this position
        int count = 0;
        
        // Count how many V's, K's, X's are before the target character in the original string
        int vCount = 0, kCount = 0, xCount = 0;
        for (char c : s) {
            if (c == 'V') vCount++;
            else if (c == 'K') kCount++;
            else xCount++;
            
            if (vCount == v && target == 'V') break;
            if (kCount == k && target == 'K') break;
            if (xCount == x && target == 'X') break;
            
            if (target == 'V' && c == 'V') continue;
            if (target == 'K' && c == 'K') continue;
            if (target == 'X' && c == 'X') continue;
            
            count++;
        }
        
        return count;
    }

    private void solve() throws IOException {
        int n = readInt();
        s = readString().toCharArray();
        int vcnt = 0, kcnt = 0, xcnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
            if (s[i] == 'V') {
                vcnt++;
            } else if (s[i] == 'K') {
                kcnt++;
            } else {
                xcnt++;
                s[i] = 'X';
            }
        }
        
        dp = new int[vcnt + 1][kcnt + 1][xcnt + 1][4];
        for (int[][][] x : dp) {
            for (int[][] xx : x) {
                for (int[] xxx : xx) {
                    Arrays.fill(xxx, -1);
                }
            }
        }
        
        int res = INF;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            res = Math.min(res, solve(vcnt, kcnt, xcnt, i));
        }
        out.println(res);
    }
}
